build_the_field_guide_behind_your_quiz_d: Build the field guide behind your quiz. Drafts stay here; approved tips become available in the quiz immediately.
work_breadth_first_approve_one_photo_for: Work breadth first: approve one photo for every species before adding second photos, then repeat. Existing pilot photos are retained. The queue follows checklist taxonomy within each round. Filters narrow what you browse; they do not bypass the global round. Species with all candidates skipped are flagged as needing replacement candidates.
read_the_linked_ebird_merlin_account_par: Read the linked eBird / Merlin account, paraphrase useful ID guidance, and inspect the actual Macaulay photo. Select up to two visible features. Click a feature’s “Place arrow” button, then click the photograph. Labels stay outside the photo in the preview. Keep explanations short; use general tips for fuller context.
saving_a_draft_does_not_publish_it_appro: Saving a draft does not publish it. Approval requires source and image checks and publishes both the photo callouts and general species tips. Editing an approved photo keeps its previous approved version live until you approve the changes. “Remove from quiz” withdraws its approved tips. Quiz histories and scores are unaffected by review work.
source_text_belongs_to_ebird_merlin_corn: Source text belongs to eBird / Merlin, Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Our summaries and placements are experimental adaptations, not Cornell-reviewed or endorsed annotations. Do not infer a feature that is hidden in a photo. No screen capture is used by this workspace.
one_candidate_per_species_saved_drafts_a: One candidate per species. Saved drafts appear first for that species.
select_place_arrow_below_then_click_the_: Select “Place arrow” below, then click the photograph.
this_photo_did_not_load_try_another_cand: This photo did not load. Try another candidate or open the Macaulay record.
one_paraphrased_tip_per_line_shown_on_ot: One paraphrased tip per line; shown on other photos without arrows.
private_to_this_workspace_not_shown_in_t: Private to this workspace; not shown in the quiz.
i_checked_these_paraphrased_tips_against: I checked these paraphrased tips against the linked eBird / Merlin account.
i_inspected_this_photo_and_checked_that_: I inspected this photo and checked that each arrow points to the visible feature described.
shared_review_progress_is_stored_on_the_: Shared review progress is stored on the server. Unsaved edits stay in this tab. Only the quiz owner can edit; other visitors can use approved tips in the quiz.
keep_recent_practice_statistics_in_this_: Keep recent practice statistics in this browser?
with_your_permission_aviquiz_keeps_aggre: With your permission, AviQuiz keeps aggregate statistics covering your five most recent completed quizzes on this device. Small contribution totals keep that rolling window accurate and support retries if the connection fails; this is not a quiz archive. You can take quizzes without allowing browser statistics storage.
signed_in_account_history_is_a_separate_: Signed-in account history is a separate setting on the Statistics page. No advertising or tracking cookies are used for these statistics. We remember your storage choice even if you decline.
what_aviquiz_stores_in_your_browser_29c4: What AviQuiz stores in your browser
if_allowed_we_keep_species_level_correct: If allowed, we keep species-level correct and attempted counts for a rolling window of five quizzes across visual and audio practice, a bounded recent-mistake buffer, and the latest comparison results. Small contribution totals, scope, medium, and synchronization identifiers let us remove old contributions and avoid duplicate uploads. We do not keep a question-by-question quiz archive, your guesses, passwords, or media files.
we_retain_one_small_storage_choice_flag_: We retain one small storage-choice flag so we can honor your decision. Sign-in uses essential session storage. Personal photo review marks are stored separately by the review feature. Browser statistics permission does not control those records or account history.
older_statistics_already_present_in_this: Older statistics already present in this browser are preserved until you explicitly import them into your account. They contain rolling answers and latest results, not a complete dated quiz log. New quizzes do not grow that old snapshot. Export it before clearing browser data if you want an additional backup.
you_can_change_browser_statistics_permis: You can change browser statistics permission on the Statistics page. Declining removes the recent-quiz cache; existing unimported history is preserved to avoid accidental loss.
